scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage MoonshadowTest#testTriggerFromAllZones.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[permanent-spec-zone-blind-in-changeszone]: ChangesZoneAll ValidCards$ Permanent.YouOwn+!token is matched against the live card already in the graveyard (non-LKI branch), and the bare Permanent base requires Zone==Battlefield when no zone context is given, so library->graveyard (mill) and hand->graveyard (discard) of permanent cards never match; only the battlefield death fires (probe: counters stay 5 after mill and after discard) (engine/rules/trigmatch/zone.go:171-175; engine/effects/filter_compiled.go:385-391). Also mill is not zone-batched (see Sidisi). CR 110.4a / 603.2.
